train-simulation-app.title: TRAIN SIMULATION APP
train-simulation-app.subtitle: Longitudinal Train Dynamics Simulator & Mamdani Fuzzy Optimizer
train-simulation-app.description: Desktop simulation and multi-objective optimization platform modeling longitudinal train physics—piecewise tractive effort curves, Davis running and track grade resistances, and multi-stage electrical power flow—paired with a self-calibrating Mamdani fuzzy inference engine to balance travel time, peak power demand, and total energy consumption.

horizon-canvas.title: HORIZON CANVAS
horizon-canvas.subtitle: GPU-Accelerated Raster-to-Vector Livery Generator for Forza Horizon
horizon-canvas.description: Desktop utility built in C++ and Qt that decomposes raster images into geometric primitives and injects their coordinates directly into Forza Horizon livery layers. Offloads the pixel-fitness scoring loop to OpenCL GPU compute kernels, evaluating millions of candidate shapes per second.

my-okane.title: MY OKANE
my-okane.subtitle: Personal Cash-Flow & Budget Ledger
my-okane.description: Personal finance and expense-tracking web application built with Nuxt for server-side rendering, Drizzle ORM and SQLite for type-safe relational persistence, and Sentry for real-time production error telemetry.

my-cars.title: MY CARS
my-cars.subtitle: Interactive 3D WebGL Nissan GT-R Showroom
my-cars.description: Real-time 3D automotive configurator dedicated to the Nissan GT-R lineage, built with Three.js, WebGL, and React. Implements physically based clearcoat car paint materials, damped camera orbit controls, factory OEM paint presets, and HDR environment lighting.

sate-itik.title: SATE ITIK
sate-itik.subtitle: Sistem Akses Terpadu Infrastruktur Jaringan TIK — Kominfo Madiun
sate-itik.description: Government network infrastructure platform built with Next.js, Drizzle ORM, and MySQL for Dinas Kominfo Kabupaten Madiun. Combines a live Mapbox GL geospatial node map, visual server-rack inventory (Racks A–D), SLA-tracked helpdesk ticketing, and role-based access via Next Auth.

my-quran.title: MY QURAN
my-quran.subtitle: Full-Stack Digital Al-Quran Reader with 3D Page-Flip View
my-quran.description: Digital Al-Quran web application featuring an interactive book page-flip interface, surah/juz indexing, ayah bookmarking, and synchronized audio recitation. Powered by a Vue 3 frontend, an Elysia.js + Drizzle ORM backend over PostgreSQL, and Dockerized deployment.

my-library.title: MY LIBRARY
my-library.subtitle: Role-Based Library Circulation & Catalog System (Laravel MVC)
my-library.description: Web-based library circulation platform that replaces manual borrowing logs. Readers can search catalog stock and submit loan requests, while librarians approve, reject, or suspend loans through a role-based admin panel built with Laravel, MySQL, and Docker.

my-library-remake.title: MY LIBRARY REMAKE
my-library-remake.subtitle: Reactive Library Management System in Livewire, Flux UI & PostgreSQL
my-library-remake.description: Full architectural rebuild of the My Library platform migrating from traditional blade views and MySQL to reactive Laravel Livewire components, Flux UI design primitives, and PostgreSQL—delivering zero-reload catalog filtering and instant loan-state transitions.

image-converter.title: IMAGE CONVERTER
image-converter.subtitle: Offline Native C++ / Qt Batch Image Transcoder & Compressor
image-converter.description: Portable offline desktop utility written in C++ and Qt for batch image format conversion and lossy/lossless size reduction. Runs 100% locally without cloud uploads or installer dependencies, supporting configurable quality thresholds in a single standalone executable.

laras.title: LARAS
laras.subtitle: Agile Self-Care & Mental Wellness Companion Platform
laras.description: Served as Frontend Developer on an 8-person cross-functional team shipping monthly production releases over an 8-month agile cycle. Built interactive journaling and wellness-tracking flows informed by iterative user testing, published on Google Play and the web.

excel-formatter.title: EXCEL FORMATTER
excel-formatter.subtitle: Portable C++ / Qt Batch Decimal & Locale Normalizer for Excel
excel-formatter.description: Standalone desktop utility that repairs inconsistent dot/comma decimal separators and corrupted numeric cells across multi-sheet Excel workbooks. Supports drag-and-drop batch processing and ships as a zero-install portable Windows executable.

bullets: Built a desktop longitudinal train simulation application in C++17 and Qt 6 (QWidgets, QChart, QFile), packaged as a standalone Windows executable via windeployqt.
Centralized shared simulation state inside a single AppContext singleton to prevent cross-module pointer races across UI and solver threads.
Split the physics engine into dedicated domain handlers—ElectricalDataHandler, TrainDataHandler, TrackDataHandler, MovingHandler, EnergyHandler, ResistanceHandler, and TractiveEffortHandler.

Implemented tractive effort curves, Davis running resistance, track grade/curvature forces, braking distances, and multi-car mass inertia using explicit unit-prefixed variables (f_, v_, p_, e_, mass_).
Added real-time QChart telemetry plotting, QFile CSV data export, and a password-protected parameter configuration screen for engineering operators.
Set up GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows to compile and verify MinGW-64 release artifacts on every push.

Built SATE-ITIK (Sistem Akses Terpadu Infrastruktur Jaringan TIK), a district-wide web platform for Dinas Kominfo Kabupaten Madiun uniting network node monitoring, staff records, server rack inventory, and helpdesk ticketing across local government agencies (OPD).

Created an interactive Mapbox GL JS dashboard plotting live coordinates, ISP providers, link types, and operational status (active, inactive, maintenance) for government network installations across sub-districts.
Developed a dual-view server rack module (visual rack elevation + tabular inventory) tracking unit status, asset tags, serial numbers, IP assignments, and hosted applications across Racks A–D.
Built an end-to-end helpdesk ticketing workflow with priority levels, SLA response/resolution timers, TipTap rich-text replies, file attachments, and automated email alerts via Resend and Nodemailer.
Modeled relational MySQL schemas using Drizzle ORM and Drizzle Kit migrations, indexing high-traffic ticket and network-node tables for fast filtering.
Secured Next.js App Router API endpoints with Zod request validation, JWT session authentication, bcrypt password hashing, and role-based access control (RBAC).
Added a multi-view OPD activity calendar (month/week/day/year) with drag-and-drop rescheduling, and containerized the application with multi-stage Docker Compose builds.

about.title: MUHAMMAD ARIEF SATRIA WIBAWA
about.subtitle: Software Engineer • Full-Stack Web, C++/Qt Desktop & 3D WebGL
about.bioP1: I am an Informatics Engineering student at Politeknik Elektronika Negeri Surabaya (PENS) and a software engineer focused on full-stack TypeScript/PHP web platforms, native C++/Qt desktop utilities, and real-time 3D WebGL interfaces.
about.bioP2: In industry internships, I engineered a C++17 and Qt 6 longitudinal train dynamics simulator at PT INKA (Persero) and built SATE-ITIK, a district-wide network infrastructure and server-rack monitoring platform using Next.js, Drizzle ORM, and Mapbox GL for Dinas Kominfo Kabupaten Madiun.
about.bioP3: Whether writing OpenCL GPU compute kernels, structuring relational schemas in PostgreSQL and MySQL, or translating Figma systems into 60 FPS Three.js and Nuxt interfaces, I focus on maintainable architecture, strict type safety, and measurable runtime performance.
